writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

forbiddenWrites: live runtime, Task Scheduler, network, external model or public state

redEvidence.cause: _validate_layer_rows checks only non-empty observed lists; removing one observation from every layer remains accepted when each list is still non-empty

requiredImplementation.target: _validate_layer_rows after realRequired, realObserved and fakeUsed list validation
requiredImplementation.rule: reject with existing LAYERS typed error when len(realObserved) < len(realRequired)
requiredImplementation.meaning: each sealed required real boundary needs at least one observation slot; surplus evidence remains permitted
requiredImplementation.preserve: all exact keys, hashes, manifest equality, unbound rejection, trusted receipts, installed authority, admission and natural validators
requiredImplementation.prohibited: no schema expansion, test change, special-case case ID, string-prefix heuristic, assertion weakening or change to error surface outside the existing typed LAYERS class

verification.directNegativeMatrix: using existing test helpers, positive validates, real_boundary_missing rejects LAYERS, and all eleven layerEvidenceCases reject
verification.s6AfterIntegration: Test Luna owns authoritative exact six pass after cherry-pick
verification.diff: git diff --check and exact one owned production path

commitPolicy.message: fix: reject incomplete S6 real boundaries

causalRetry: one implementation attempt only; any unrelated failure returns to Sol without test edits
delivery: source hash/bytes, positive and 11-negative evidence, commit and clean status
stopPolicy: return to Sol; no tests/live/global mutation
